title: Pumpkin Candle/Light Holder Jack O Lantern - Looks Homemade (goes around candle)
descriptionText: Add a touch of homemade charm to your candle display with this Pumpkin Candle/Light Holder. The Jack O Lantern design goes around the candle, creating a cozy and rustic ambiance. The holder is perfect for any lantern or candle, making it a versatile addition to your collection. The pumpkin pattern adds a touch of seasonal cheer and the brand is Homemade, adding a unique touch to your decor. This Candle Holder is perfect for collectors or anyone looking for a cozy and rustic addition to their home.
